tokens.title: Visual system
tokens.subtitle: Ticket A2 · token verification page
tokens.intro: This page is not the product; it is a check sheet. Every value comes from the tokens in globals.css, so it is easy to see whether they match the visual system spec. E1 replaces this page entirely.
tokens.colorNote: Four materials, not four colours. Switch day/night at the top right — everything should change together.
tokens.ratioNote: A hard rule. More than one cell of cinnabar is a mistake, not a style choice.
tokens.typeNote: Song for the frame, Spectral alongside it, Noto Sans TC for utility only. Line height 1.95, 32–40 characters per line, never embolden Chinese.

specimen.lead: Your Life Palace falls in Shen.
specimen.body: Zi Wei Dou Shu carries the structure of a life across twelve palaces. It speaks of tendencies, not conclusions.
specimen.sm: This passage is inference, not assertion.

tokens.layoutNote: Text block 690px, head margin 104px, foot margin 64px (8:5). The frame below is the real text-block width.
tokens.motionNote: Three panels below animate in. All start from a visible state: with JS off, or reduced motion on, the content is complete — it simply does not move.
tokens.motionOneNote: Scrolling back up does not replay it.
tokens.motionThreeNote: 900ms in — three times a typical site.
tokens.nextUp: Next ticket: B3 — settle the three school divergences

ask.name: Whose name should this book carry? You may leave it blank; the book will then read 無名, “nameless”.
ask.date: Your date of birth on the Gregorian calendar. We convert it to the lunar calendar for you.
ask.sex: The chart needs this: whether your ten-year periods run forward or backward depends on the year's yin or yang and your sex.

mulu: The Three Directions and Four Squares
The Body Palace and the Five-Element Bureau
… then one chapter for each palace, eleven in all
cast.muluNote1: The chapters are fixed before you enter your birth details.
cast.muluNote2: Once you do, they fill with your text.
cast.timeHint: Use the clock time on your birth certificate. We handle daylight saving ourselves.
cast.slotsLoading: Working out the hours of that day…
cast.noHourComfort: Without the hour we can't place the Life Palace, so this book will stay on your shelf with a dotted spine, waiting for its hour. It is usually on the birth certificate, and family can often remember. Add the hour and the book is complete.
cast.awaitBody1: The year, month and day are in place; the Life Palace is still waiting for the hour. The book will stay on your shelf with a dotted spine.
cast.awaitBody2: Add the hour and the book is complete.

errors.BAD_REQUEST: Something in these birth details looks off. Please go back a step and check.
errors.OUT_OF_RANGE: Our calendar covers 1900 to 2100. This birth date is outside it for now.
errors.BAD_PLACE: This place's coordinates look wrong. Please choose it again.
errors.BAD_TIMEZONE: We couldn't recognise this time zone. Please choose the place of birth again.
errors.UNKNOWN_HOUR: Without the hour we cannot place the Life Palace. Please choose "Hour unknown".

shelf.unavailable: We can't reach your shelf right now. Your books are safe — please try again in a moment.
shelf.claimPrompt: These books are only known to this browser.
shelf.intro: Every book of yours is here. Choose a spine to open it, or start a new one on the far right.

book.missing: This book isn't on your shelf.
book.unavailable: We can't reach this book right now. It is safe — please try again in a moment.
book.noChapter: This book doesn't have that chapter.
book.intro: Come to know yourself, slowly, through your chart.
book.prefaceLead: Opening: what your chart looks like
book.uncutNote: Chapters marked “uncut” are pages of this book not yet opened — their titles are listed so you can see what they hold. One payment opens every deeper chapter in this book.

time.title: Time
time.lead: Where you are on your life's path

shi.title: Work and direction
shi.lead: Finding a path that suits you

book.epilogueLead: A few lines to take with you: your strengths, what to keep in mind, and what is worth doing now.

weicai.notYet: This page has not been cut open yet.
weicai.hintAnonymous: Leave an email to keep this book, then open it.
weicai.hintClaimed: One payment opens every deeper chapter in this book.

claim.title: Keep your books
claim.risk: Right now these books are known only to this browser. Clear its data, switch devices or browsers, and they cannot be found again — we have no other way to recognise you.
claim.how: Leave an email and the books are kept under that address. We will send a confirmation email; open the link inside and it is done.
claim.forCutting: Once that is done, we will take you straight to opening this book.
claim.linkFailed: This verification link has expired, or was opened in a different browser. Please send it again from this browser.
claim.readFree: Go back to the free chapters first
claim.promise1: This email is only used to recognise your books. No promotional mail.
claim.promise2: One letter a year, before Lichun (the start of spring), about the year ahead. You can turn it off in Settings.
claim.sent: A confirmation email is on its way to {email}. Open the link inside and these books are yours — it will bring you back here.

errors.invalid: This email address looks incomplete. Please check it again.
errors.noBooks: There are no books in this browser. If your books are on another device, keep them from there.
errors.already: These books have already been kept.
errors.taken: This email already has another account. Sign in to that account, or use a different email.
errors.rate_limited: We just sent one. Please wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.unknown: We could not send the confirmation email just now. Please try again later.

pay.title: Open the book
pay.unreachable: We cannot connect at the moment. Nothing is wrong on your side, and your book and any payment are safe — try this page again in a little while.
pay.explain1: Old thread-bound books came with their page edges uncut; the reader cut them open. The deeper chapters of this book are those uncut pages.
pay.explain2: Open once and every deeper chapter in the book is yours — not chapter by chapter, and no renewal. The free chapters you are reading stay exactly as they are.
pay.stripe1: Payment happens on Stripe. Your card number never passes through us.
pay.stripe2: We only learn that this book has been paid for, not which card you used.

signed-out.message: There are no books in this browser. If your book is on another device, open it there.
signed-out.label: Shelf

anonymous.message: Keep this book with an email before opening it — otherwise clearing your browser data would lose the book and any opened pages.
anonymous.label: Keep it

not-yours.message: We could not find this book.
not-yours.label: Shelf

untitled.message: This book is still waiting for its hour. Add the birth hour and it will have a name.
untitled.label: Add the hour

paid.title: Opened
paid.body: Every deeper chapter of the book is now yours. Go back to your shelf, or turn straight to the next chapter.

pending.title: Received
pending.body: We've received your payment. It takes a moment to confirm; once it does, the book opens by itself — no need to stay on this page.

cancelled.title: Not opened
cancelled.body: No payment was made this time, and the book is as it was. Come back whenever you are ready; the uncut pages will be here.

errors.noBook: We could not find this book.
errors.blocked: This book cannot be opened right now.
errors.failed: We could not open the payment page just now. Please try again later.

account.title: Settings
account.unreachable: We cannot connect at the moment. Your books and data are safe — try this page again in a little while.
account.noBooks: There are no books in this browser. If your books are on another device, open them there.
account.unclaimed: These books have not been kept with an email yet — only this browser knows them.
account.export1: A JSON file with every birth you have written, every chart and every book.
account.export2: Opened chapters include their text; uncut chapters include only their titles and section names — those have not been purchased, and the file says so.
account.exportNote: Uncut deeper chapters have a null body — they have not been purchased; nothing is missing from this file.
account.exportFailed: We could not export just now. Please try again later.
account.recastIntro: The method and the writing will be revised over time. The books you have will not change with them — each remembers the settings it was made with.
account.recastEmpty: There are no books on your shelf yet.
account.recastLink: Make another book from the same birth →

recast.none: This book uses the same settings as today.
recast.unknown: This book did not record which version made it — that is a data problem for us to fix, not the same as “unchanged”.
recast.action: To see what the new version makes of it, make another book from the same birth. This one will not change; both will stay on your shelf for you to compare.

account.chongpaiTitle: Changed since this book was made
account.chongpaiNote: The book you have has not changed and will not change by itself. To see the new version, make another one; both will stay on your shelf for you to compare.

effect.engine: Some cells of the chart may differ
effect.school: School choices such as the four transformations or star strength may differ
effect.content: The writing may have been revised; the chart is the same

account.deleteIntro: This is a real deletion, not hiding. Once deleted it is gone, and we keep no backup to restore it from.
removeList: Every birth you have written (name, date, hour, place)
Every book, including the text of opened chapters
The link between your purchases and your account
keepList: A payment record linked to no one (amount, date, Stripe transaction ID) — kept because accounting law requires it
account.deleteMismatch: Type the word exactly as shown to delete.

deleteOutcome.gone: Everything has been deleted. This account and its contents no longer exist.
deleteOutcome.partial: Your births, charts and books have been deleted, but the account itself (your email) could not be. We need to do that step on our side — please write to us and we will finish it.
deleteOutcome.failed: We could not delete just now. Nothing has been deleted — please try again later.

lexicon.title: Library
lexicon.description: Entries on Zi Wei Dou Shu: the fourteen major stars, the twelve palaces, the four transformations and the five-element bureaus. Every entry names its source, and every quotation can be checked word for word.
lexicon.intro: Entries on Zi Wei Dou Shu. Each names its source; quotations are copied word for word from the original texts, so you can check them yourself.
lexicon.twoSourcesNote: Every “two sources” so far comes from different chapters of the Complete Book of Zi Wei Dou Shu — two places in one text, a single witness. This number will not change until a second book is in hand.
lexicon.school: Following the San He school · Zhongzhou school (Wang Tingzhi).
lexicon.noPersonal: Nothing here involves anyone’s chart — no birth details, no casting, no account.
lexicon.noPersonalEntry: This page involves no one’s chart — no birth details, no casting, no account.
lexicon.oneWitness: All quotations above come from different chapters of “{book}” — two places in one text, a single witness. This entry has not yet been checked against a second book.
lexicon.manyBooks: The quotations above come from {count} books: {books}.
lexicon.ctaLead: These entries are also used to write a book of your own.

consent.title: Before you begin
consent.point1: Your birth details, place of birth and name are used only to cast your chart and write your book. We never sell them or use them for advertising.
consent.point2: Your book is a reading based on classical Zi Wei Dou Shu texts. It is not medical, legal, financial or other professional advice; important decisions are yours to make.
consent.point3: You can export or permanently delete your data at any time in Settings.
consent.read: By continuing you confirm you have read and agree to the <terms>Terms of Use</terms> and <privacy>Privacy Policy</privacy>.

sample.metaDescription: A sample Stellogue book, cast for an invented birth date — see how a book reads before you begin your own.
sample.title: Sample book
sample.note: This sample is cast for an invented birth date, with every page open. Your own book is cast from your birth details, so every chapter reads differently. Books are currently written in Chinese.
sample.endBody: Every line in it comes from the chart. With your birth details, it becomes another book — one that is only yours.
sample.missing: The sample book has no such chapter.
